services.title: Three clear home design packages | ECO ARCH
services.description: Choose 2D preliminary design, 3D concept design or complete architecture and interior design. See what each includes, then book a call with ECO ARCH.

prelim.title: 2D preliminary design for existing homes | ECO ARCH
prelim.description: Preliminary design package: one 2D plan option for your existing home, with notes on function, sun and ventilation. For before you need 3D views.

ideas.title: 3D concept design for renovations | ECO ARCH
ideas.description: Concept design package: plan, elevations, sections and architectural perspectives to picture your home after renovation. AI-assisted, architect-checked.

complete.title: Complete architecture and interior design | ECO ARCH
complete.description: Complete package: a full design, architectural and interior perspectives and detailed documents per contract, for construction preparation. Book a call.

concepts.title: Hanoi home design concepts (illustrative) | ECO ARCH
concepts.description: Illustrative design concepts for tube houses, townhouses, villas and apartments in Hanoi, with before and after views. Concepts, not built projects.

tubeHouse.h1: Tube house: keep the arch, change the light
tubeHouse.title: Hanoi tube house: keep the arch, change the light | ECO ARCH
tubeHouse.description: Illustrative concept for a Hanoi tube house: keep the arch and curved stair, rework layout and lighting. An ECO ARCH concept, not a built project.

townhouse.h1: Townhouse: vertical fins and indigo gate
townhouse.title: Hanoi townhouse: vertical fins and indigo gate | ECO ARCH
townhouse.description: Illustrative concept for a Hanoi townhouse facade: terracotta vertical fins for climbers, an indigo gate, the old balcony kept. An ECO ARCH concept.

villa.h1: Villa living room opening to the garden
villa.title: Villa living room opening to the garden | ECO ARCH
villa.description: Illustrative concept for a villa living room: keep the columns and glazed doors, rework furniture, curtains and terrazzo floor to open to the garden.

apartment.title: Apartment: warm timber, reworked layout | ECO ARCH
apartment.description: Illustrative concept for an apartment: timber kitchen, bench with storage, folding dining table and sliding screen for flexible use. An ECO ARCH concept.

scope.title: Scope and deliverables | ECO ARCH
scope.description: Know in advance which survey record, choice explanation sheet and handover list you receive, and how changes and acceptance are handled.

readSunWind.description: Hot, stuffy or dark Hanoi homes often start with the layout. How to read your plot's sun and wind before deciding how rooms are arranged.

faq.description: Answers on scope, documents, cost, construction and how to work with ECO ARCH. One place to check before you book a call.

book.description: Send the location, building type and expected timing. ECO ARCH replies within 24 hours to arrange a call. You do not need drawings yet.

hero.body: ECO ARCH is a design consultancy for architecture, interiors and home renovation. We read the sun, wind and plot before drawing a plan, then explain each choice in documents with a clear scope. We do not build.
